fixes.explanation: That's the one, baker. Solomon didn't consign any Israelites to slave labor, because they were his men of war, the leaders of his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry (2 Chronicles 8:9). Verse 10 adds that they were also his chief officers, 250 supervisors (2 Chronicles 8:10). I think that's a team nobody wanted to be late to a meeting with.
